newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - May 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde - May 5.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.
-- Zaire's President Mobutu Sese Seko agrees to step down, seeks to negotiate terms of departure, and calls for a presidential election in which he would not be a candidate.

-- European bond market to rival the U.S. market when Europe shifts to a single currency. EMU will put an end to currency-related risks, but disparities between bond yields are expected to linger within the euro zone, and investors are likely to rely increasingly on rating agencies' notes to assess borrowers.
-- Pilots at Air France Europe to carry on strike through May 6 to protest against terms of their planned merger with Air France.
-- Toyota seeks new industrial site in Europe, does not rule out investing in France.
